scope: Strict response contract for the private location-scoped energy monitoring summary.

constraints.activity_types: match energy_reading activity_type constraint plus unspecified aggregate bucket
constraints.percentages: bounded from 0 through 100 where the calculation defines a percentage
constraints.groups: at most 98, from two reading types, seven source types, and seven activity buckets
constraints.trend: at most eight daily points from the inclusive seven-day query window
constraints.efficiency_history: at most 12 records, matching the query limit
constraints.renewable_groups: at most five schema-constrained renewable types
constraints.energy_cost_currencies: three uppercase letters, matching migration 604; at most 26 cubed distinct codes
constraints.validation: Explicitly validate the service projection before constructing JSONResponse
constraints.request_path: summary location identifier must match the location in the route path

error_contract.invalid_projection: sanitized 500 with Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie

limitations: This closes one response-contract slice only; it does not establish live OIDC behavior, populated-data parity, or broad tenant isolation.
